title: Listening Calendar
description: A year of listening laid out a month at a time: every day is the cover of the album you played most, sized by how long you listened. Hover or tap a day and the side panel shows its cover, minutes and the songs in order; the month bars above jump through the year.
intent: A listening heatmap where the heat is the artwork: cover size carries the minutes, a month grid keeps the covers big enough to read, and the detail lives in one fixed panel instead of a tooltip chasing the pointer.
